# fct_booking_platform_rates

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_booking_platform_rates` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for booking platform rate requests with program availability analysis and rate parity monitoring. Each row represents a single rate request. Sourced from Portal (via data loaded directly into BigQuery).

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `booking_platform_request_supplier_key` | Primary Key. Composite key combining request_id and supplier_id to uniquely identify each rate request per hotel supplier. Ensures one row per request per hotel. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_uuid` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for the advisor who made the rate request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `check_in_date` | Check-in date for the stay of the requested rate. This is equivalent to the 'Start Date' of a Booking. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `check_out_date` | Check-out date for the stay of the requested rate. This is equivalent to the 'End Date' of a Booking. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_adults` | Number of adults in the rate request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_children` | Number of children in the rate request. >> SOURCE - Portal # - name: count_expected_programs #   description: Count of programs that should be available for a supplier. >> SOURCE - Portal # - name: count_missing_programs #   description: Count of programs that were expected but did not return rates (rate gaps). Calculated as count_expected_programs minus count_returned_programs. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_nights` | Number of nights calculated from check-in and check-out dates of the rate request. >> SOURCE - Portal # - name: count_returned_programs #   description: Count of programs that actually returned rates for this request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_rooms` | Number of rooms requested. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `expected_programs_list` | Array of program names that should be available for a supplier based on supplier_to_programs mapping. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_program_missing_fora_rates` | True/false flag indicating whether Fora Rates were expected but did not return (rate gap). Post Fora Reserve 2.0, the legacy Fora Reserve / Fora Preferred / Enhanced Rates programs are normalized into Fora Rates. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_program_missing_hyatt_prive` | True/false flag indicating whether Hyatt Prive rates were expected but did not return (rate gap). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_program_missing_virtuoso` | True/false flag indicating whether Virtuoso rates were expected but did not return (rate gap). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_fora_rates_parity_issue` | True/false flag indicating whether the cheapest refundable Fora Rates rate is higher than the cheapest refundable rate from any partner program for the same room type (rate parity issue). Compares rates only for matching room codes. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_fora_rates_parity_issue_vs_regular` | True/false flag indicating whether the cheapest refundable Fora Rates rate is higher than the cheapest refundable Regular rate for the same room type (rate parity issue). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_fora_rates_parity_issue_vs_virtuoso` | True/false flag indicating whether the cheapest refundable Fora Rates rate is higher than the cheapest refundable Virtuoso rate for the same room type (rate parity issue). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_fora_rates_parity_issue_vs_hyatt_prive` | True/false flag indicating whether the cheapest refundable Fora Rates rate is higher than the cheapest refundable Hyatt Prive rate for the same room type (rate parity issue). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_virtuoso_parity_issue_vs_regular` | True/false flag indicating whether the cheapest refundable Virtuoso rate is higher than the cheapest refundable Regular rate for the same room type. Anchored on the cheapest Virtuoso room (independent of Fora Rates). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_ujv_parity_issue_vs_regular` | True/false flag indicating whether the cheapest refundable UJV rate is higher than the cheapest refundable Regular rate.  >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_tablet_parity_issue_vs_regular` | True/false flag indicating whether the cheapest refundable Tablet rate is higher than the cheapest refundable Regular rate.  >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_webbeds_parity_issue_vs_regular` | True/false flag indicating whether the cheapest refundable WebBeds rate is higher than the cheapest refundable Regular rate. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_rate_request_errored` | True/false flag indicating whether the rate request hit any error, i.e. the request did not complete cleanly. Used to exclude incomplete/errored requests from missing-rate outreach. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_regular_rate_returned` | True/false flag indicating whether Regular Rates are returned, based on if visible_programs_list includes 'Regular Rates'. Since 'Regular Rates' are not a Program, it is not included in supplier_to_programs. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `fora_rates_room_description` | Human-readable room description for the cheapest refundable Fora Rates rate (e.g., 'King Deluxe Ocean View'). Useful for investigating rate parity issues. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `fora_rates_rate_description` | Rate plan description for the cheapest refundable Fora Rates rate (e.g., 'Flexible Rate - Free Cancellation'). Useful for investigating rate parity issues. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `fora_rates_source_rate_identifier` | Full source rate identifier for the cheapest refundable Fora Rates rate. Used for debugging and detailed rate analysis. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_fora_rates_rate_usd` | Minimum refundable Fora Rates rate in USD for the cheapest room type. Used as baseline for room-level rate parity comparison. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `fora_rates_commission_percent` | Commission % on the cheapest refundable Fora Rates rate. Where the feed returns 0 on a rate marked as commissionable, we assume 10% per Fora's confirmed standard. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `regular_rates_room_description` | Human-readable room description for the cheapest refundable Regular rate matching the Fora Rates room code. Null if no Regular rate exists for that room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `regular_rates_rate_description` | Rate plan description for the cheapest refundable Regular rate matching the Fora Rates room code. Null if no Regular rate exists for that room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `regular_rates_source_rate_identifier` | Full source rate identifier for the cheapest refundable Regular rate matching the Fora Rates room code. Null if no Regular rate exists for that room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_expedia_rate_usd` | Minimum refundable Expedia rate returned (in USD). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_regular_rate_usd` | Minimum refundable Regular rate in USD for the same room type as the cheapest Fora Rates rate. Null if no Regular rate exists for that room. Used for room-level rate parity comparison. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `regular_commission_percent` | Commission % on the cheapest refundable Regular rate matching the Fora Rates room. Where the feed returns 0 on a rate marked as commissionable, we assume 10% per Fora's confirmed standard. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_virtuoso_rate_usd` | Minimum refundable Virtuoso rate in USD for the same room type as the cheapest Fora Rates rate. Null if no Virtuoso rate exists for that room. Used for room-level rate parity comparison. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `virtuoso_commission_percent` | Commission % on the cheapest refundable Virtuoso rate at the Fora Rates room, so it is directly comparable to the Fora Rates and Regular commissions. Where the feed returns 0 on a rate marked as commissionable, we assume 10% per Fora's confirmed standard. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_hyatt_prive_rate_usd` | Minimum refundable Hyatt Prive rate in USD for the same room type as the cheapest Fora Rates rate. Null if no Hyatt Prive rate exists for that room. Used for room-level rate parity comparison. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_partner_rate_usd` | Minimum refundable rate in USD for the same room type as the cheapest Fora Rates rate, across all partner programs except Fora Rates, Expedia, TAAP, and Tablet. Null if no partner rates exist for that room. Used for room-level rate parity comparison. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `virtuoso_room_code` | Three-character room code extracted from the source_rate_identifier for the cheapest refundable Virtuoso rate. Anchors the Virtuoso-vs-Regular parity comparison. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_virtuoso_rate_vs_regular_usd` | Minimum refundable Virtuoso rate in USD for the cheapest Virtuoso room type. Distinct from min_virtuoso_rate_usd, which is Virtuoso priced at the cheapest Fora Rates room (for the Fora-Rates-vs-Virtuoso comparison). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_regular_rate_vs_virtuoso_usd` | Minimum refundable Regular rate in USD for the same room type as the cheapest Virtuoso rate. Null if no Regular rate exists for that room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_regular_rate_any_room_usd` | Minimum refundable Regular Rate retuned (in USD). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_virtuoso_rate_any_room_usd` | Minimum refundable Virtuoso rate returned (in USD). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_ujv_rate_usd` | Minimum refundable UJV rate returned (in USD). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_tablet_rate_usd` | Minimum refundable Tablet rate returned (in USD). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `min_webbeds_rate_usd` | Minimum refundable Webbeds rate returned (in USD). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `missing_programs_list` | Array of program names that were expected but did not return rates (rate gaps). Calculated as expected_programs_list minus visible_programs_list. Fora Rates variations are normalized. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `program_with_best_rate` | Name of the program with the lowest refundable rate for the same room type as the cheapest Fora Rates rate. Excludes Expedia, TAAP, and Tablet. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `portal_url` | Direct URL to view this hotel search in the Fora advisor portal. Used for validating rate parity issues. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `rate_provider` | The rate provider that returned the rates (e.g. Travelport). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `rate_requested_at` | Timestamp when the rate request was made. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `rate_request_error` | The error(s) for the rate request ('error:provider_exception', 'stopped:max_cycles', 'stopped:infinite_loop', or a combination). Null when the rate request is successful. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `request_purpose` | Purpose of the rate request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `request_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for each rate request from the booking platform. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `request_type` | Type of rate request (e.g. multiple rate request). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `room_code` | Three-character room code extracted from the source_rate_identifier for the cheapest refundable Fora Rates rate. Used to ensure room-level rate parity comparisons. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for the supplier (hotel). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_name` | Name of the supplier. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `visible_programs_list` | Array of program names that actually returned rates and are visible in Portal for this request.
